raw_text: We're a small dental practice and keep losing revenue to no-shows. Can you help us send automated reminders and predict who's likely to skip their appointment? We use a basic scheduling app right now.
Our prior-authorization process is a mess — staff manually re-key requests into three different insurance portals from our EHR. We want this automated end to end.
Our physicians spend an hour a night on notes. We want an AI tool that turns dictated visit notes into structured chart entries in our EHR format.
We'd like a simple monthly dashboard showing patient volume trends from our billing spreadsheet exports. No names, just aggregate counts by service type.
We're exploring whether AGVs could move dialysate and biohazard waste between treatment rooms instead of staff carrying it by hand.
We're opening a new surgical wing in 6 weeks and want robotic supply carts wired into our inventory system from day one. This is time-sensitive.
Patients fill out an intake form describing their symptoms and we want it auto-routed to the right specialist queue instead of a nurse triaging every single one.
Our research division wants a pipeline analyzing de-identified clinical trial outcomes across our five sites to spot treatment efficacy trends.
We're a healthcare startup and know we want to 'do something with AI' but honestly haven't figured out what yet. Can you help us figure out where to start?
Billing errors keep happening because we don't check insurance eligibility before appointments. We need this automated ASAP, it's costing us real money every week.
We want autonomous disinfection robots deployed across all our ICU wings, integrated with our facilities management system, rolled out across every site in our network.
We want a chatbot patients can ask billing questions to, pulling directly from their claims history.
